prothrombin time; international normalized ratio; von willebrand antigen; erythrocyte sedimentation rate; c-reactive protein; lupus anticoagulant proﬁle (negative); cardiolipin; immu- noglobulins m, a, and g; acetylcholine-binding anti- body; muscle-modulating antibody; and striational antibodies. coincidently, the patient also developed recurrent sinopulmonary infections and skin infections from small skin breaks, requiring monthly courses of antibiotics for over 1 year. her immune eval- uation was consistent with cvid ( etable 1). the patient had poor antibody responses to polysaccharide an- tigensafterbothapneumococcalvaccineanditsconjugatedversion and was diagnosed with cvid in 2014. she was started on intra- venous immunoglobulin at 400 mg/kg monthly. the patient’s neurologic symptoms of pain and rigidity remained, albeit improv- ing within the ﬁrst 6 months of intravenous immunoglobulin (ivig) treatment. three years later, in 2017, she was again tested for the anti-gad65 antibody, which was positive at 41.2iu/ml (reference range, <5.0iu/ml). anti-gad antibodies can also be seen in dia- betes mellitus. the patient had never been diagnosed with diabetes mellitus(typeiorii).duringherevaluationcourse,shehadafasting glucose of 93. her intravenous immunoglobulin dose was in- creased to 1g/kg considering the sps diagnosis as well as changing to a non–glycine-stabilized ivig formulation. although there is not enough evidence for a direct causal rela- tionship between cvid and sps, more research into a possible link is necessary, especially in light of associations seen with other au- toimmune disorders and primary immunodeﬁciency. supplementary data supplementarydatarelatedtothisarticlecanbefoundat https:// doi.org/10.1016/j.anai.2018.01.002. jason schend,d o* dave mcgarry,d o† john johnson,d o† robert hostoffer,d o†,‡ *mercy health hospital mercy campus muskegon, michigan †university hospitals cleveland medical center cleveland, ohio ‡allergy/immunology association, inc mayﬁeld heights, ohio jason.schend@gmail.com references [1] tam j, routes j. common variable immunodeﬁciency.am j rhinol allergy. 2013;
